packageRules.description: [automerge] Lock file maintenance stays manual here, overriding the library preset. FastAPI declares only starlette>=0.46.0, so a maintenance refresh can move the runtime-imported starlette (lso/auth.py, lso/oidc.py) without touching pyproject.toml. A package rule cannot prevent that: lock file maintenance carries no depName, so matchPackageNames never applies to it

[automerge] Starlette is imported by runtime code (lso/auth.py, lso/oidc.py) although it is declared only in the dev group, so a dev-group bump must be reviewed. This covers the direct dev-group entry, not lock file maintenance; the rule above covers that

[pin] redis-py must stay below 6.5: kombu does not notice redis-py 8+ dropping the broker socket, so workers stay deaf after a reconnect. 6.5 and above are excluded too, because that is where the incompatibility was seen; see the pin and its comment in pyproject.toml
[cooldown] nwa-stdlib is our own package and exempt from the uv cooldown, so it is exempt from Renovate's release age too. Keep in sync with exclude-newer-package in pyproject.toml

[cooldown] certifi is exempt from the uv cooldown so CA-distrust advisories land immediately, so it is exempt from Renovate's release age too. Keep in sync with exclude-newer-package in pyproject.toml

[disable] Dockerfile.example is not managed by Renovate: ignorePaths "Dockerfile" is a substring match, so it also hides Dockerfile.example. If that is narrowed to "^Dockerfile$", this keeps the example image off python majors the requires-python range (>=3.12,<3.15) does not support. It is disabled rather than constrained because an allowedVersions regex tight enough to exclude the next major also blocks patch updates
